name_en: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: The government puts money in a fixed deposit for your girl child. If you have one girl, it is Rs 50,000. If you have two girls, it is Rs 25,000 for each girl. From the 6th year, she gets Rs 1,800 a year. At age 18 she gets the money with interest, but only if she writes the 10th standard public exam.

other: Your family has only one girl (Scheme I) or only two girls (Scheme II), and no boy.
One parent must have had a family planning operation before age 40.
Parents or grandparents must be from Tamil Nadu by birth, or must have lived here for at least 10 years.
Apply before the child turns 3 (for two girls, before the second girl turns 3).
Girls of Sri Lankan Tamil refugees in Tamil Nadu camps can also get it.

how_to_apply: Get copies of your papers. Go to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Give your fingerprint there. Fill the form, upload your papers and ask for a receipt.
where_to_apply: Nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). For questions, ask the District Social Welfare Officer.
